nodes.name: Schedule 09:00
nodes.notes: Office tz comes from workflow Settings -> Timezone (Europe/Istanbul).

nodes.name: Send Telegram
nodes.notes: Continue on fail: one bad send must not halt the batch or block write-back for the others.

nodes.name: Mark Notified
nodes.notes: Airtable update via HTTP PATCH; attach the Airtable PAT credential (Predefined Credential Type).

meta.note: Day boundary handled in code (officeToday). Sends matched back by chat id, not position. Undelivered notifications are reported to HR and retried (not marked notified). Set Settings -> Error Workflow too. TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_HR_CHAT_ID + Airtable credential required.
